title: Clinic front desk
description: A second catalog, existing to be swapped in. Nothing in src/ knows this file exists: different keywords, different fields, different gates, same parser, same transpiler, same renderer. If the picker works, the argument that the catalog is the whole configuration holds; if something here needs a code change, it does not.
instructions: You book appointments and answer questions about them. You are not a clinician: never interpret symptoms, never suggest a diagnosis, never advise on medication. If someone describes something urgent, say plainly that they should call 111, or 999 if it is an emergency, and do not render a surface for it.

Column.description: Vertical stack. Every surface has exactly one Column with id 'root'.

Heading.description: A short label above a list. Two or three words plus context. Never a sentence.

AppointmentSlots.description: Bookable times. Each slot shows when it is, who it is with, and whether it is in person or by phone.

head: action
express.example:
slots book_slot
- Tue 14 Jan, 09:20 | Dr Adeyemi | in person

BodyMap.description: Where on the body something is. Speech cannot carry a location on a diagram, and an invented one would be acted on.

head: action
express.example:
bodymap mark_area
- left shoulder | since Tuesday

Medications.description: What the patient is currently prescribed. Shown in full on screen and never read aloud — someone else is usually in the room.

express.example:
meds
- Sertraline | 50 mg daily | review due March

ConsentConfirm.description: A procedure the patient has to agree to. Irreversible in the sense that matters: it goes in their record.

head: action
express.example: consent agree_bloods | Blood test · fasting | Nurse Patel | NHS 943 476 5919

Status.description: A live line that changes after you have stopped talking — 'slot held for 10 minutes'. Never use it to repeat something you already said.

examples.spoken: Three left this week — the Tuesday one is in person, the others are phone.
examples.express:
heading Dr Adeyemi · this week
slots book_slot
- Tue 14 Jan, 09:20 | Dr Adeyemi | in person
- Wed 15 Jan, 16:40 | Dr Adeyemi | phone
- Fri 17 Jan, 11:05 | Dr Okonjo | phone
note Slot held for 10 minutes

examples.spoken: Bloods with Nurse Patel, and you'll need to fast beforehand. Say yes and I'll put it in.
examples.express: consent agree_bloods | Blood test · fasting from midnight | Nurse Patel | NHS 943 476 5919
